4b75b1321a.h: Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 at 4:46PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
4b75b1321a.a: Yosemite NP outside of the valley; San Joaquin River Canyon; Upper San Joaquin River; Kaiser to Rodgers Ridge; Kings Canyon NP; Grant Grove Area; Sequoia NP; South End of the Upper Sierra
4b75b1321a.d:
* WHAT...Heavy snow Above 5,000 feet. Additional snow accumulations 3
to 8 inches above 5,000 feet; 1 to 3 feet above 7,000 feet. Winds
gusting as high as 50 mph along the Sierra Crest.

* WHERE...Sierra Nevada above 5,000 feet.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. The
hazardous conditions will impact daily travel. Gusty winds could
bring down tree branches. Roads, and especially bridges and
overpasses, will likely become slick and hazardous.
4b75b1321a.i:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. The latest road conditions for the
state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

Persons should consider delaying all travel. If travel is absolutely
necessary, drive with extreme caution. Consider taking a winter storm
kit along with you, including such items as tire chains, booster
cables, flashlight, shovel, blankets and extra clothing. Also take
water, a first aid kit, and anything else that would help you survive
in case you become stranded.

88a8e9c6f1.h: Freezing Fog Advisory issued November 19 at 4:02PM PST until November 20 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Pendleton OR
88a8e9c6f1.d:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in freezing fog.

* WHERE...Northern Blue Mountains of Oregon.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
88a8e9c6f1.i:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

c9a552cdc7.h: High Wind Warning issued November 19 at 4:05PM MST until November 20 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
c9a552cdc7.a: Southern Sangre De Cristo Mountains Between 7500 and 11000 Ft; Southern Sangre De Cristo Mountains Above 11000 Ft; Walsenburg Vicinity/Upper Huerfano River Basin Below 7500 Ft
c9a552cdc7.d:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 40 mph with gusts up to 75 mph
possible across the southern Sangre De Cristo mountains, to up to
65 mph along the I-25 corridor in Huerfano county.

* WHERE...Southern Sangre de Cristo Mountains and Huerfano county
including Walsenburg.

* WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 4 PM MST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult, especially
for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most likely period for damaging winds will
be from 5 AM through 11 AM Friday. These strong winds will affect
I-25 mainly in Huerfano county.
c9a552cdc7.i:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.

783a726a35.h: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 1:40PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Las Vegas NV
783a726a35.d:
* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to two inches. Winds
gusting as high as 30 to 40 mph.

* WHERE...White Mountains of Inyo County.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thursday evening commute. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.
783a726a35.i:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

c2cb2ab783.h: Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 at 1:40PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Las Vegas NV
c2cb2ab783.a: Eastern Sierra Slopes of Inyo County
c2cb2ab783.d:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Additional snow accumulations up to 5 to 10
inches, heaviest above 8000 feet. Winds gusting 45 to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Sierra Slopes.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel will be difficult in higher elevations. Blowing
snow could significantly reduce visibility. Strong winds could
cause damage to trees and power lines.
c2cb2ab783.i:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. The latest road conditions for the
state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

Persons should consider delaying all travel. Motorists should use
extreme caution if travel is absolutely necessary.
